But I know for a fact that he's not that good because when I googled his name, there was nothing showing up about his supposed boxing career. That makes me think he's lying. I'm 19 and have been training in Muay Thai for eight years, and I also wrestled in high school. I'm really fit and proud of my progress in martial arts and fitness. I used to be overweight too, so I know how hard it is to get into shape. That's why I find Jackson's lies so frustrating because he's not giving credit to the hard work it takes to be good at martial arts. We don't usually hang out outside of work because he never stops talking about himself and his supposed achievements. But last weekend, we were hanging out, having a few beers, and watching UFC. By calling him out in front of others, did I damage our working relationship? Could it lead to a hostile work environment? In the end, I need to decide whether the benefits of calling him out outweigh the potential negative consequences.
